The Mysterious Letter

Sarah found the letter under her door on Tuesday morning. It was plain white with no stamp, just her name written in dark ink. "Meet me at the old clock tower at midnight," it read. Her heart raced as she stared at the words. Who could have sent this? She hadn't been to the clock tower since childhood.

That night, Sarah stood beneath the tower's shadow. The air was cold and still. A figure emerged from the darkness. "You shouldn't have come," a voice whispered. Before she could respond, the figure vanished. Sarah was left alone, clutching the letter, wondering what secret she had just uncovered.
